note: Rejudged after 438bb234e4 changed handleLCPPacket: Code-Reject and Protocol-Reject now map to RXJ+ or RXJ- by what they reject, stopRejectedCode records a rejected Echo Code, and an RXJ- records lcpRejectFatalReason. Re-read Section 5.1. The Identifier lifecycle runs through the ValidateLCPReply check, the Nak/Reject option block and the RCN/RCA transitions into sendConfigureRequest, all ahead of or beside the new Code-Reject branches and byte-identical; a Configure-Ack, Nak or Reject never enters them. The tagged units are unchanged. TestLCPConfigureRequestIdentifierLifecycle still requires a new Identifier after changed options and after a valid Ack with unchanged options, keeps the timeout retransmission's bytes and Identifier, and leaves the current request in place on a stale Ack. The client Nak and MRU/Magic/all-option Reject probes still require differing replacement Identifiers, refuse the old Ack and complete on the replacement Ack. The verdict holds. The client revert records still prove reachability only; the exact Identifier assertions carry the proof.
